```{python}
import csv
import json

from IPython.display import HTML, Markdown

from fc_distill.figures import LABELS
from fc_distill.story import HEADLINE, ROOT, Story

story = Story.load()
M = story.methods
splits = {k: len(v) for k, v in json.loads((ROOT / "data" / "splits.json").read_text()).items()}
with open(ROOT / "data" / "audit" / "test_labels.csv") as f:
    audit = list(csv.DictReader(f))


h = story.headline()
serve = story.serving()
verdicts = {v: sum(r["verdict"] == v for r in audit) for v in ("label_ambiguous", "label_wrong")}
defaults_rows = M["defaults"]["B"]["rows"]
teacher = M["teacher"]
last = {k: M["methods"][k]["checkpoints"][-1] for k in M["methods"]}
d_budget = M["at_b_budget"]["D"]
d_cost = next(c for c in M["methods"]["D"]["checkpoints"] if c["step"] == M["methods"]["D"]["selected"])["gpu_hours"]
b_cost = next(c for c in M["methods"]["B"]["checkpoints"] if c["step"] == M["methods"]["B"]["selected"])["gpu_hours"]
bg_cost = next(c for c in M["methods"]["Bg"]["checkpoints"] if c["step"] == M["methods"]["Bg"]["selected"])["gpu_hours"]
b_clean = M["methods"]["B"]["official"]["test-clean"]["exact"]
bt = next(c for c in M["claims"] if (c["a"], c["b"], c["eval"]) == ("B", "raw 2B", "test-clean"))
tie_gap = max(abs(M["methods"][k]["official"]["test-clean"]["exact"] - b_clean) for k in ("C", "D"))


def bfcl_selected(key: str) -> dict:
    m = M["methods"][key]
    return next(c for c in m["checkpoints"] if c["step"] == m["selected"])["bfcl"]


def pct(x: float, digits: int = 1) -> str:
    return f"{100 * x:.{digits}f}%"


def n(x: int) -> str:
    return f"{x:,}"


def wandb(key: str) -> Markdown:
    return Markdown(f"[W&B]({story.facts(key)['wandb']})")


def badge_html(key: str, title: str = "") -> str:
    css = {"B→D": "BD"}.get(key, key)
    tip = f' title="{title}"' if title else ""
    return f'<span class="m m-{css}"{tip}>{LABELS[key]}</span>'


def badge(key: str) -> Markdown:
    """A method's name as a badge in its chart colour, for prose."""
    return Markdown(badge_html(key))


def table(keys: list[str], baselines: bool = False) -> HTML:
    """The results table for `keys`, each at its selected checkpoint, grouped by whether its
    training reads gold; the two untrained models on top if asked."""
    cols = ["Validation", "Test", "Test-clean", "BFCL"]
    head = "".join(f"<th>{c}</th>" for c in ["Method", "Step", "GPU-h", *cols])
    rows = []
    if baselines:
        rows.append('<tr class="group"><td colspan="7">No training</td></tr>')
        for who, what in (("raw 0.8B", "the student, untrained"), ("raw 2B", "the teacher")):
            scores = [story.score(who, s) for s in ("validation", "test", "test-clean", "bfcl")]
            cells = [f'{who}<span class="mname">{what}</span>', "", "0", *scores]
            rows.append('<tr class="baseline">' + _cells(cells) + "</tr>")
    groups = [("No labels", [k for k in keys if story.facts(k)["labels"] == "no"]),
              ("Uses labels", [k for k in keys if story.facts(k)["labels"] == "yes"])]
    for group, members in groups:
        if baselines and members:
            rows.append(f'<tr class="group"><td colspan="7">{group}</td></tr>')
        for k in members:
            f = story.facts(k)
            cells = [badge_html(k) + f'<span class="mname">{f["name"]}</span>', f["step"],
                     f["gpu_hours"], f["validation"], f["test"], f["test_clean"], f["bfcl"]]
            cls = ' class="headline"' if k == HEADLINE else ""
            rows.append(f"<tr{cls}>" + _cells(cells) + "</tr>")
    return HTML(
        f'<div class="table-scroll"><table class="results"><thead><tr>{head}</tr></thead>'
        f"<tbody>{''.join(rows)}</tbody></table></div>"
    )


def ladder() -> HTML:
    """The headline on one 50-100% track: the student before, its teacher, the student after
    distillation, and the same recipe on gold labels."""
    points = [
        ("raw 0.8B", "the 0.8B before", "#898781", "down", False),
        ("raw 2B", "its 2B teacher", "#52514e", "up", False),
        (HEADLINE, "the 0.8B, distilled", "#2a78d6", "down", False),
        ("A", "trained on gold labels", "#52514e", "up", True),
    ]
    pos = lambda x: f"{(x - 50) * 2:.2f}%"  # noqa: E731
    parts = ['<div class="track"></div>']
    parts += [f'<span class="tick" style="left:{pos(t)}">{t}%</span>' for t in (50, 60, 70, 80, 90, 100)]
    for who, text, colour, side, hollow in points:
        x = 100 * story._exact(who, "test-clean")
        left = pos(x)
        parts.append(f'<span class="pt{" hollow" if hollow else ""}" style="left:{left};--c:{colour}"></span>')
        parts.append(f'<span class="lab {side}" style="left:{left};--c:{colour}"><b>{x:.1f}%</b><span>{text}</span></span>')
    return HTML(f'<div class="ladder" role="img" aria-label="Exact match on xLAM test-clean">{"".join(parts)}</div>')


def _cells(cells: list[str]) -> str:
    return "".join(f"<td>{c}</td>" for c in cells)
```
